mockExams.title: GCE O Level mock — Physics
mockExams.instructions: Answer all questions. The paper is marked out of 20: Section A has 8 multiple-choice questions (1 mark each) and Sections B to D are structured questions with the marks shown for each part. Use g = 10 N/kg and c(water) = 4200 J/kg °C. This is an original practice paper: its format is to be checked against the official texts of the Cameroon GCE Board.
